decoder.webm is a generated one-second 64x48/10fps VP9 video with mono 440 Hz Opus audio. It contains FFmpeg testsrc/sine output only, no third-party assets. Generation: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc=size=64x48:rate=10 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=8000 -t 1 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a libopus decoder.webm. Used for real browser frame-zero and resampled PCM acceptance.
